lines.text: A Chinese scribe got a bonus of oxen. This bronze is his receipt.
But words on perishable things vanish.
So Ling had them cast in bronze.
But how do you cast words?
The text was probably copied into the clay mould first.
But a mould around a model must come off.
So it was cut in sections. The model became the core.
Then bronze filled the gap, carved masks and all.
Nearly 190 characters, cast twice, still readable about three thousand years later.
